## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (or new tests added for the behavior)
- [ ] Updated `.env.example` and `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` for any new/changed env vars
- [ ] Added a Prisma migration (if schema changed) and CI's `prisma-migrate-dry-run` is green
- [ ] Added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## Unreleased`
